capability: Merge two knowledge bases without hiding conflicts
title: Merge, and keep the seams.

hook.picture: Close: the whale braids two lines, one per team, into one rope. Where they twist, one team's dot slides over the other's and the covered dot vanishes.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We merged both teams' docs, and now nobody trusts either.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Many braided lines, each with dents where one team's dot was quietly covered by the other's. Three more covers happen, accelerating.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: The last edit wins. The other just vanishes.

stakes.body: Two teams' knowledge becomes one source nobody believes. People go back to asking each other, and the merge was wasted.

solution_hint: Keep both answers. Lose nothing without a note.

metaphor.body: Two team lines are laid side by side. Wherever they meet, a seam shows whether they agree. Disagreements stay visible in one marked box instead of one covering the other.

steps.picture: The two lines lie side by side. At each shared dot a dashed seam appears, and where the two dots agree, the seam turns teal with a tick.
A chip appears on a teal seam.
At a seam where the dots disagree, the seam glows raw sienna. Both dots stay, stacked side by side in one marked box.
steps.words: Disagree? Keep both. Mark the seam.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.3). The whale tries to let one dot slip off the edge. A gate closes, and the dot slides back with a note tick.
steps.words: Nothing dropped without a written note.

steps.picture: Ticks run along the strip: one per joined, kept or flagged dot.

real_case.claim: The memory graph merge of the 437-entity atlas and 111 new lab entities produced 548 entities, with conflicts kept, not smoothed.

honest_limit.picture: Two dots for one thing, under different names, sit apart on the merged line. No seam forms and nothing glows, so the duplicate passes.
honest_limit.words: Two names for one thing slip past.

not_this.body: Zero conflicts found usually means look again.

ending_pattern.body: The two pods that got opposite answers ask again. Both read the marked box and give the same answer with the same note.
ending_pattern.callback: In bar 3 two pods got opposite answers from the rope. Now, in the same framing, both get one answer and both see the conflict.

end_belief.body: When you merge, keep conflicts visible.
